title: Swahili Spiced Beef Ribs
community: Swahili coast — the coastal beef rib tradition
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Swahili Beef Ribs — beef ribs marinated in Zanzibar spices and tamarind, slow-simmered until very tender, then finished over charcoal for a magnificently caramelised exterior. Two-stage cooking: the simmer for tenderness, the grill for glory.
longDesc: Swahili beef ribs use the two-stage technique — slow simmer first for complete tenderness, then the charcoal grill for the caramelised, spiced exterior. The result is ribs of extraordinary texture: falling-tender within, magnificently charred without.
steps: Blend marinade ingredients to a smooth paste. Coat ribs. Marinate 4 hours.
Place marinated ribs in a pot. Cover with water. Simmer covered 70—80 minutes until very tender.
Grill over medium-high charcoal 8—10 minutes per side until magnificently charred and caramelised.
chefTips: The simmer must produce completely tender ribs before grilling.
The marinade caramelises beautifully in the final grill.
cookingScience: See TZA043 for two-stage cooking science.
culturalNote: Swahili spiced beef ribs are the coastal feast food — the two-stage preparation that takes time and care, making them the right dish for occasions when the host wants to show how seriously they take the guests.
